tools.name: get_notary_info
tools.description: No auth needed. Price, min confirmations, spec version, and supported hash algorithms.

tools.name: prepare_anchor
tools.description: Anchors content_hash on chain. Returns a partially-signed transaction (operator co-signed its fee input) -- add your own witness for from_address and submit. idempotency_key (optional) returns the same prior result on retry instead of building a new transaction.

tools.name: prepare_decision_log
tools.description: Appends one entry to your hash-chained decision log. content_hash is the hash of your own RFC-8785-canonicalized decision record (never send the record itself -- see docs/decision-record-v1.md). seq starts at 0 and increments by 1 each call; prev must equal the previous entry's content_hash (omit on

tools.name: check_anchor_status
tools.description: Looks up a previously prepared anchor or decision-log entry by proof_id. Requires the api_key that created it.

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Authoritative on-chain check by tx_hash (and/or content_hash to compare against). No auth needed -- anyone holding a tx hash can verify it, like a receipt. Optionally pass content to re-hash locally server-side (never stored/logged).

tools.name: verify_decision_chain
tools.description: Independently checks a decision-log chain's integrity from chain data alone (gap-free seq, prev matches, each entry anchored). No auth needed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_anchor_status" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
